business_problem: Electrolux needed a globally scalable data platform for connected-appliance applications so it could capture telemetry, personalize the customer dashboard, and keep pace with growing numbers of devices without maintaining databases itself.
solution_summary: Electrolux uses MongoDB Atlas as the backend for a mobile experience that lets consumers monitor and control connected household appliances from a single dashboard. The team first validated MongoDB in a self-hosted deployment, then moved to Atlas so it could stop hosting, patching, and upgrading the database itself while still supporting fast reads and writes at global scale. Appliance events such as cycle times, start and end timestamps, power consumption, and maintenance alerts are ingested into Atlas and associated with individual customers and devices, giving the app a personalized, continuously updated view of usage. In lower-traffic environments the team uses serverless MongoDB rather than provisioning separate instances, which keeps the platform simple to operate. The result is a managed analytics and telemetry layer that helps Electrolux improve sustainability messaging, streamline application development, and support long-term growth in connected appliances.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores appliance telemetry and customer context for the connected-home application platform.

solution_components.name: serverless MongoDB
solution_components.role: Provides lightweight database capacity for environments where traffic is expected to stay low.

data_flow: Connected appliances send event and telemetry data into MongoDB Atlas, the backend associates those signals with each user and registered device, and the mobile application turns that data into personalized dashboards, usage insights, and maintenance alerts.
business_outcome: Electrolux gave customers more informative and sustainable appliance experiences while gaining a simpler, more scalable way to support growth in connected devices and regional deployments.
